newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent retraces gains as NYMEX misses call.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent retraces gains as NYMEX misses call.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures retraced gains as a weak opening on NYMEX crude and products helped the market unwind a thin rally, brokers said.
"The rally was made over lunch and volumes were very thin," a broker said. "It was inspired by the products and then Brent found little resistance."
May Brent was trading three cents up at $19.77 a barrel, off a session high of $19.77. April gas oil was trading $3.00 up at $172.50 a tonne.
"NYMEX didn't make the call and we came right off, which shows how thin (the rally) was," a dealer said.
Traders said that expectations of colder weather on the U.S. East coast had pushed some buyers into the IPE gas oil market which had a knock-on effect to Brent.
But NYMEX heating oil failed to sustain modest early gains and was trading just 0.2 cents a gallon up down at 55.25 cents at 1530 GMT.
